hooks.command: if [ -d "$(pwd)/docs" ]; then if [ -f "$(pwd)/docs/.jdm-indexed" ]; then echo '{"systemMessage": "jdocmunch is available and docs are indexed. Use search_sections, get_toc, get_section for doc exploration instead of Read."}'; else echo '{"systemMessage": "jdocmunch: docs/ exists but is not indexed. Run: roborepo index docs docs/"}'; fi; fi
